### Design Philosophy

"Small set of tools that enable complete workflows, rather than just atomic actions" —
balances flexibility and efficiency for LLMs [14].

### Known Tools

- `findTasksByDate` — query tasks by date [14]
- `addTasks` — create tasks [14]
- Full list in `src/tools` directory (not enumerated in README) [14]

### Client Support

Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code CLI, VS Code [14]. Claude Code setup:

```
claude mcp add --transport http todoist https://ai.todoist.net/mcp
```

[14]

### Additional Features

- MCP Apps: interactive UI widgets for rich visual representations [14]
- OpenAI MCP spec compatible (search + fetch tools) [14]
- Previous repo `Doist/todoist-mcp` deprecated, redirects to todoist-ai [14]

## Read-Only Mode Support

No MCP server (official or community) implements a `--read-only` flag [14][15]. However:

- Todoist API supports `data:read` OAuth scope for read-only access [3]
- Scoped OAuth tokens enforce read-only at the API level regardless of MCP server [3]
- greirson's dry-run mode (`DRYRUN=true`) simulates writes without executing them [15]
- Using a personal API token inherently grants full access; OAuth scoping is the only
  mechanism for read restriction [3]

## PA Integration Recommendation

- **Official server** is better for hosted/production use (maintained by Doist, OAuth-based,
  hosted endpoint reduces infrastructure) [14]
- **greirson server** offers more granular tools and simpler auth (API token), which may
  be preferable for a self-hosted PA where you control the token scope [15]
- For read-only advisory PA, either server works with `data:read` scoped OAuth tokens [3]

## Gaps and Limitations

- Official server's full tool list not publicly enumerated in README [14]
- No MCP server implements read-only mode as a flag [14][15]
- Community server data (stanislavlysenko0912, abhiz123) from search snippets only [16][17]
